security.title: JDBC Driver for SQL Server has improper input validation issue
security.description:
[CVE-2025-59250](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-m494-w24q-6f7w): JDBC Driver for SQL Server has improper input validation issue

Severity: HIGH

Affected dependencies:
- com.microsoft.sqlserver:mssql-jdbc:12.6.1.jre8 (declared at build.gradle:13) — recommended fix: upgrade to a patched version

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: The application contains hard-coded default RabbitMQ credentials (username/password set to "guest") in both source code defaults and configuration properties.

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
security.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

evidence.explanation: The application contains hard-coded default RabbitMQ credentials (username/password set to "guest") in both source code defaults and configuration properties.
